title: Tenma Tsukasa — Shining Stars Onstage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: ASTRO FES - Day 1
Ensemble Square - Studio

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Do you think Tsukasa is nearby?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Len, I'm sure I don't need to remind you, but be sure to stay quiet. Everyone is practicing hard for the joint performance tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I know! We did just see Rui working on effects with the idols' Magician.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I wonder who Tsukasa is practicing with?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Ah! Look, KAITO, there he is!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, you're right. He's standing face-to-face with someone... But, wait...>

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: You sicken me! Begone from my sight!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <The atmosphere is so hostile.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <A-Are they fighting? What should we do?!>

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Tenma...☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Morisawa...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <H-Huh? They were just glaring at each other, but now they're shaking hands?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was some superb acting!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: I could say the same for you! You looked so sad that, even though I knew we were just acting, I actually felt really guilty.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After all, our characters may have had a falling-out, but they were once the closest of friends...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't help but get emotional thinking about it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, they were just acting.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, it looks like they get along very well in real life.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your technique really surprised me, Morisawa. I knew RYUSEITAI did superhero shows, but to think you were so accomplished...

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Well! It's really nice of you to say that, given how hard you're working as an actor yourself!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: But, hmm... I think it helps that it's an easy role to play.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: An easy role? How do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: In hero shows, it's pretty common for conflicts to start over differing definitions of justice.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: So this type of acting, where you're facing each other with righteous anger, is sought after.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: And with your help, I feel like I was able to reach higher than I usually can. That's that genuine star power that brings smiles to so many faces!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That said, I don't yet have the skill or the achievements to be called a star.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However... Someday I will become worthy of the title! I swear it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For that and many other reasons, I must approach every role with diligence and care!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: So, you're just like me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: I'm working as hard as I can to become my ideal awesome hero, too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really? From where I stand, you and the other RYUSEITAI members already appear to be fine heroes bringing smiles and hope to children.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: I'm happy to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: But the way I see it, I'm not in RYUSEITAI because I'm a hero. I'm in RYUSEITAI because I want to BECOME a hero.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Reality can be harsh, and it can be hard to keep fighting for your own justice like the heroes on TV do...

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: But I've kept on fighting for what I believe in, and that's gotten me this far.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: And some people look at me standing here, and are kind enough to call me a hero for it.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll let me call you a star!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: You're chasing after your dreams, and that makes you brilliant!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Morisawa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you! I see I'll have to redouble my efforts, in order to be worthy of your kind words.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Right. Let's work hard to reach our dreams, together! This joint production will be a big step forward for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Let's shine bright up on stage and bring huge smiles to everyone who's come to see us☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Now then, let's do it again from the top, and practice the songs too! If anything sticks out to you, be sure to let me know.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. Please tell me if you notice anything, yourself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <He's pretty dazzling, isn't he?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <He is! And... I feel like the two of them are actually really similar!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Good luck, you two! We're looking forward to your brilliant performance!>
